title: Downgraded operator hub previews hide unpublished commerce
detail: HubLinks reused browsableAreas for the real operator while the shell correctly suppressed operator privilege in a downgraded preview. A hidden Store link therefore remained in the hub and sent the preview into a redirect. The hub now derives public areas from the existing cached visibility reader when previewing down, keeping ordinary operator navigation intact. A mock viewer test reproduced shop full before and requires none after; navigation/visibility regressions remain covered.
